",

      function enhanceSolutionCards() {

        });
      }
      function renderGateGuide(key) {
        const image = GUIDE_IMAGES[key] || GUIDE_IMAGES.central;
        const meta = GUIDE_META[key] || GUIDE_META.central;
        if (!$("#gateGuideImage")) return;
        $("#gateGuideImage").src = image;
        $("#gateGuideImage").alt = `${meta[0]}实拍导视`;
        $("#gateGuideImage").style.objectPosition = GUIDE_FOCUS[key] || "50% 45%";
        $("#gateGuideBadge").textContent = meta[0];
        $("#gateGuideTitle").textContent = meta[0];
        $("#gateGuideCaption").textContent = meta[1];
        $("#gateGuideOpen").onclick = () => {
          $("#photoModalImage").src = image;
          $("#photoModalImage").alt = `${meta[0]}实拍导视大图`;
          $("#photoModalTitle").textContent = meta[0];
          $("#photoModalCaption").textContent = meta[1];
          $("#photoModal").classList.remove("hidden");
        };
      }
      function enhanceCharging() {
        $("#chargeUsbImage").src = CHARGE_USB_IMAGE;
        $("#chargeDeskImage").src = I("p55.jpg");
        $("#chargeSupplyImage").src = findProduct("emergency", "miniso-charge").image;
      }

      const state = {
        traveller: "departure",
        need: "meeting",
        zone: "n2",
        selected: "seesaw-n2",
        selectedPublic: "pub-n2",
        mapTargetKind: "shop",
        userXY: null,
        positionMode: false,
        capacity: "waiting",
        mapFilter: "all",
        publicZone: "n2",
        timer: null,
        left: 0,
      };
      function toast(t) {
        const x = $("#toast");
        x.textContent = t;
        x.classList.add("show");
        setTimeout(() => x.classList.remove("show"), 2400);
      }
      function zoneName(k) {
        return zones[k].name;
      }
      function gateZone(value) {
        const gate = Number(String(value || "").match(/\d{3}/)?.[0]);
        if (gate >= 101 && gate <= 108) return "n1";
        if (gate >= 109 && gate <= 127) return "n2";
        if (gate >= 128 && gate <= 149) return "n3";
        if (gate >= 156 && gate <= 169) return "s3";
        if (gate >= 170 && gate <= 187) return "s2";
        if (gate >= 188 && gate <= 197) return "s1";
        return null;
      }
      function gateLabel(value, fallback = "待录入登机口") {
        const raw = String(value || "").trim();
        if (!raw) return fallback;
        return raw.endsWith("登机口") ? raw : raw + "登机口";
      }
      function currentShop() {
        return shops.find((x) => x.id === state.selected) || shops[0];
      }
      function img(p) {
        return typeof p === "string" ? p : I(`p${p}.jpg`);
      }
      function setOptions() {
        const o = Object.entries(zones)
          .map(([k, v]) => `<option value="${k}">${v.name}</option>`)
          .join("");
        $("#zone").innerHTML = o;
        $("#zone").value = state.zone;
      }
      function minutes(shop) {
        if (state.traveller === "arrival")
          return +$("#arrivalStay").value || 45;
        const time = $("#boarding").value;
        if (!time) return "—";
        const [h, m] = time.split(":").map(Number),
          n = new Date(),
          t = new Date();
        t.setHours(h, m, 0, 0);
        if (t < n) t.setDate(t.getDate() + 1);
        const transit =
          shop.zone === state.zone
            ? 8
            : shop.zone === "central" || state.zone === "central"
              ? 16
              : 24;
        return Math.max(
          0,
          Math.round((t - n) / 60000) - +$("#buffer").value - transit,
        );
      }
      function score(s) {
        const from = currentUserXY();
        const to = mapXY(s);
        const distance = Math.hypot(from[0] - to[0], from[1] - to[1]);
        let x =
          (s.zone === state.zone ? 40 : 0) +
          (s.need.includes(state.need) ? 40 : 0) +
          Math.max(0, 34 - distance * 0.9);
        if (state.traveller === "arrival" && s.need.includes("arrival"))
          x += 50;
        if (state.traveller === "departure") {
          let m = minutes(s);
          if (typeof m === "number") x += Math.max(-30, Math.min(20, m));
        }
        return x;
      }
      function recommendations() {
        let r = shops
          .filter(
            (s) =>
              s.need.includes(state.need) ||
              (state.traveller === "arrival" && s.need.includes("arrival")),
          )
          .sort((a, b) => score(b) - score(a));
        return r.slice(0, 3);
      }
      function updateHome() {
        let arrival = state.traveller === "arrival";
        $("#departureForm").classList.toggle("hidden", arrival);
        $("#arrivalForm").classList.toggle("hidden", !arrival);
        $("#bufferWrap").classList.toggle("hidden", arrival);
        $("#homeStatus").textContent = arrival
          ? "到达旅客｜请填写到达登机口"
          : "出发旅客｜请录入登机信息";
        $("#homeStatusText").textContent = arrival
          ? "根据到达登机口匹配所在登机口区域附近资源。"
          : "根据登机时间、登机口和安全缓冲生成建议。";
        state.zone = arrival
          ? gateZone($("#arrivalGate").value) || state.zone
          : $("#zone").value || state.zone;
        state.userXY = null;
        state.positionMode = false;
        $("#zone").value = state.zone;
        renderAll();
      }
      function renderReco() {
        const list = recommendations();
        $("#recommendInfo").textContent =
          state.traveller === "arrival"
            ? `当前位置：${zoneName(state.zone)}｜显示附近短停资源。`
            : `当前位置：${zoneName(state.zone)}｜安全缓冲：${$("#buffer").value}分钟。`;
        $("#recoList").innerHTML = list
          .map((s, i) => {
            let m = minutes(s),
              meta =
                state.traveller === "arrival"
                  ? `预计停留 ${m} 分钟`
                  : m === "—"
                    ? "请先填写登机时间"
                    : `可安排约 ${m} 分钟`;
            return `<article class="reco"><span class="rank">0${i + 1}</span><img src="${img(s.photos[0])}" alt="${s.name}现场照片"><div><b>${s.name}｜近 ${s.gates}</b><span>${zoneName(s.zone)}｜登机口导向 ${s.gates}</span><span>${s.desc}</span><span class="tag green">${meta}</span></div><button class="btn primary sm" data-plan="${s.id}">纳入行程</button></article>`;
          })
          .join("");
      }
      function mapXY(s) {
        if (shopCoordinates[s.id]) return shopCoordinates[s.id];
        let base = zones[s.zone].xy;
        let n = (shops.filter((x) => x.zone === s.zone).indexOf(s) - 1) * 1.5;
        return [base[0] + n, base[1] + n];
      }
      function currentUserXY() {
        return state.userXY || zones[state.zone].xy;
      }
      function currentMapTarget() {
        if (state.mapTargetKind === "public")
          return (
            publicPoints.find((x) => x.id === state.selectedPublic) ||
            publicPoints[0]
          );
        return currentShop();
      }
      function targetXY(target) {
        return state.mapTargetKind === "public" ? target.xy : mapXY(target);
      }
      function nearestZoneKey(point) {
        return Object.entries(zones).reduce(
          (best, [key, zone]) => {
            const distance =
              (zone.xy[0] - point[0]) ** 2 + (zone.xy[1] - point[1]) ** 2;
            return distance < best.distance ? { key, distance } : best;
          },
          { key: "central", distance: Infinity },
        ).key;
      }
      function nearestSpineIndex(spine, point) {
        let best = 0,
          distance = Infinity;
        spine.forEach((p, i) => {
          const d = (p[0] - point[0]) ** 2 + (p[1] - point[1]) ** 2;
          if (d < distance) {
            distance = d;
            best = i;
          }
        });
        return best;
      }
      function corridorRoute(fromZone, targetZone, target, start) {
        const fromSpine =
          corridorSpines[fromZone] || [zones.central.xy, zones[fromZone].xy];
        const toSpine =
          corridorSpines[targetZone] || [zones.central.xy, zones[targetZone].xy];
        const fromIndex = nearestSpineIndex(fromSpine, start);
        const toIndex = nearestSpineIndex(toSpine, target);
        let points;
        if (fromZone === targetZone) {
          const middle =
            fromIndex <= toIndex
              ? fromSpine.slice(fromIndex + 1, toIndex + 1)
              : fromSpine.slice(toIndex, fromIndex).reverse();
          points = [start, ...middle, target];
        } else {
          const toCentre = fromSpine.slice(0, fromIndex + 1).reverse();
          const fromCentre = toSpine.slice(1, toIndex + 1);
          points = [start, ...toCentre, ...fromCentre, target];
        }
        return points.filter(
          (point, index) =>
            index === 0 ||
            point[0] !== points[index - 1][0] ||
            point[1] !== points[index - 1][1],
        );
      }
      function renderMap() {
        if (state.mapFilter === "public" && state.mapTargetKind !== "public") {
          const localPublic =
            publicPoints.find((x) => x.zone === state.zone) ||
            publicPoints.find((x) => x.zone === "central") ||
            publicPoints[0];
          state.selectedPublic = localPublic.id;
          state.mapTargetKind = "public";
        }
        if (state.mapFilter === "merchant" && state.mapTargetKind !== "shop")
          state.mapTargetKind = "shop";
        const sel = currentMapTarget(),
          from = currentUserXY(),
          to = targetXY(sel);
        $("#you").style.left = from[0] + "%";
        $("#you").style.top = from[1] + "%";
        $("#you").classList.toggle("moving", state.positionMode);
        const points = corridorRoute(state.zone, sel.zone, to, from);
        const route = points
          .map((point, index) => `${index ? "L" : "M"}${point[0]} ${point[1]}`)
          .join(" ");
        $("#routePath").setAttribute("d", route);
        $("#routeGlow").setAttribute("d", route);
        $("#routeFlow").setAttribute("d", route);
        $("#routeEnd").setAttribute("cx", to[0]);
        $("#routeEnd").setAttribute("cy", to[1]);
        $("#mapNote").textContent =
          state.positionMode
            ? "改当前位置｜请在地图上点击新的位置"
            : `实时路线｜当前位置 → ${sel.name}`;
        $("#mapLabels").innerHTML = mapAnnotations
          .map(
            (x) =>
              `<span class="map-label ${x.end ? "end" : ""} ${x.range ? "range" : ""}" style="left:${x.x}%;top:${x.y}%">${x.label}</span>`,
          )
          .join("");
        let visible = shops.filter(
          (s) =>
            state.mapFilter === "all" ||
            state.mapFilter === "merchant" ||
            (state.mapFilter === "local" && s.zone === state.zone),
        );
        let pubs = publicPoints.filter(
          (p) =>
            state.mapFilter === "all" ||
            state.mapFilter === "public" ||
            (state.mapFilter === "local" && p.zone === state.zone),
        );
        $("#mapPins").innerHTML =
          visible
            .map((s) => {
              let [x, y] = mapXY(s);
              const active =
                state.mapTargetKind === "shop" && s.id === state.selected;
              return `<button class="map-pin ${active ? "active" : ""}" style="left:${x}%;top:${y}%" data-map="${s.id}" data-label="${s.name}｜近${s.gates}" aria-label="${s.name}｜近${s.gates}"></button>`;
            })
            .join("") +
          pubs
            .map((p) => {
              let [x, y] = p.xy;
              const active =
                state.mapTargetKind === "public" &&
                p.id === state.selectedPublic;
              return `<button class="map-pin public ${active ? "active" : ""}" style="left:${x}%;top:${y}%" data-publicmap="${p.id}" data-label="${p.name}｜${p.gates}" aria-label="${p.name}｜${p.gates}"></button>`;
            })
            .join("");
        $("#mapDetail").innerHTML =
          state.mapTargetKind === "public"
            ? `<img src="${img(sel.photos[0])}" alt="${sel.name}现场照片"><span class="tag green">${zoneName(sel.zone)}</span><h3>${sel.name}｜近 ${sel.gates}</h3><p>${sel.desc}</p><p class="micro">临近登机口：${sel.gates}<br>公共区域免费使用，座位余量以现场为准。</p><div class="actions"><button class="btn sm" data-photo="public:${sel.id}:0">查看现场</button><button class="btn sm" data-publiczone="${sel.zone}">查看公共办公区</button><button class="btn primary sm" data-charge>快速充电服务</button></div>`
            : `<img src="${img(sel.photos[0])}" alt="${sel.name}现场照片"><span class="tag">${zoneName(sel.zone)}</span><h3>${sel.name}｜近 ${sel.gates}</h3><p>${sel.desc}</p><p class="micro">登机口导向：${sel.gates}<br>路线已在地图上常亮显示。</p><div class="actions"><button class="btn sm" data-photo="shop:${sel.id}:0">查看现场</button><button class="btn sm" data-corridor="${sel.zone}">查看分区点位</button><button class="btn primary sm" data-plan="${sel.id}">纳入行程</button></div>`;
        $$("[data-mapfilter]").forEach((b) =>
          b.classList.toggle("active", b.dataset.mapfilter === state.mapFilter),
        );
        bindDynamic();
      }
      function renderCorridor(key = state.zone) {
        state.corridor = key;
        const tabs = Object.entries(zones)
          .map(
            ([k, v]) =>
              `<button class="corridor-tab ${k === key ? "active" : ""}" data-corridor="${k}">${v.name}</button>`,

        $("#corridorTitle").textContent = zones[key].name;
        $("#corridorDesc").textContent = zones[key].desc;
        renderGateGuide(key);

        $("#corridorGrid").innerHTML = list.length
          ? list
              .map(

                  `<article class="shop"><img src="${img(s.photos[0])}" alt="${s.name}现场照片"><div class="copy"><span class="gate">登机口导向：${s.gates}</span><h3>${s.name}｜近 ${s.gates}</h3><p>${s.desc}</p><div class="actions"><button class="btn sm" data-photo="shop:${s.id}">查看现场</button><button class="btn sm" data-map="${s.id}">地图位置</button><button class="btn primary sm" data-plan="${s.id}">纳入行程</button></div></div></article>`,
              )
              .join("")
          : '<p class="micro">该区域暂无商户点位，可查看下方公共服务资源。</p>';
        $("#resourceList").innerHTML = (resources[key] || ["公共候机资源"])

          .join("");
        bindDynamic();
      }
      function renderPublic(key = state.publicZone) {
        state.publicZone = key;

        $("#publicTabs").innerHTML = Object.entries(zones)

        $("#publicTitle").textContent = zoneName(key) + "公共办公区";

        const scenes = [

        $("#publicGrid").innerHTML =

                `<article class="shop"><img src="${img(photo)}" alt="${x.name}${scenes[i]}实景照片"><div class="copy"><span class="gate">${scenes[i]}｜近 ${x.gates}</span><h3>${x.name}｜近 ${x.gates}</h3><p>${x.desc}</p><div class="actions"><button class="btn sm" data-photo="public:${x.id}:${i}">查看现场</button><button class="btn sm" data-publicmap="${x.id}">地图位置</button><button class="btn primary sm" data-charge>快速充电服务</button></div></div></article>`,
            )
            .join("") || '<p class="micro">该区域公共资源信息待补充。</p>';
        bindDynamic();

      function renderJourney() {
        let s = currentShop(),
          m = minutes(s),

        if (!state.timer) state.left = Math.max(0, min * 60);
        $("#journeyShop").textContent = `当前安排｜${s.name}｜近 ${s.gates}`;
        $("#journeyCopy").textContent =

          (state.traveller === "arrival"
            ? "到达后短停安排。"
            : m === "—"
              ? "请补充登机时间，以计算可用窗口。"
              : "当前可安排约 " + m + " 分钟，并已保留安全缓冲。");
        $("#journeyPreview").innerHTML =

        $("#journeyMeta").innerHTML =

        let rows =

      function refreshTimer() {

        $("#timer").textContent = m + ":" + s;
        const max = Math.max(
          1,
          (typeof minutes(currentShop()) === "number"
            ? minutes(currentShop())
            : 1) * 60,
        );
        $("#timerMeter").style.width =
          Math.max(0, Math.min(100, (l / max) * 100)) + "%";
        $("#timerContext").textContent =
          l > 0
            ? `当前窗口尚余 ${m}:${s}，请同步关注航班显示与现场广播。`
            : "窗口已结束，请立即按现场导向返回登机流程。";

      function availabilityRows() {
        let s = currentShop(),
          f =
            state.traveller === "arrival"
              ? "到达旅客｜当前区域 " + zoneName(state.zone)
              : `出发旅客｜${$("#boarding").value || "待录入登机时间"}｜${gateLabel($("#gate").value)}`;
        return [
          ["行程状态", f],
          ["航旅纵横", "待接入：航班、登机口与登机状态"],
          ["商户位置", `${zoneName(s.zone)}｜${s.gates}`],
          ["商户接口", "待接入：座位余量与接待能力"],
        ]
          .map(
            (x) =>
              `<div class="data-row"><span>${x[0]}</span><b>${x[1]}</b></div>`,
          )
          .join("");
      }
      function openAvailability(id) {
        if (id) state.selected = id;
        state.capacity = "waiting";
        let s = currentShop();
        $("#availabilityName").textContent = `${s.name}｜近 ${s.gates}`;
        $("#availabilityRows").innerHTML = availabilityRows();
        $("#availabilityModal").classList.remove("hidden");
        setCapacity("waiting");
      }
      function setCapacity(v) {
        state.capacity = v;
        let ring = $("#statusRing"),
          title = $("#availabilityState"),
          sub = $("#availabilitySub"),
          reserve = $("#reserve");
        ring.classList.remove("full");
        reserve.classList.add("hidden");
        if (v === "waiting") {
          ring.textContent = "待查询";
          title.textContent = "正在等待商户接口返回";
          sub.textContent = "点击“查询接待能力”查看当前余量。";
        } else if (v === "full") {
          ring.textContent = "暂满";
          ring.classList.add("full");
          title.textContent = "该时段暂无法接待";
          sub.textContent = "可返回附近优选，选择其他可服务商户。";
        } else {
          ring.textContent = "可预定";
          title.textContent = "可承接本次商务停留";
          sub.textContent = "演示状态：可进入一键预定流程。";
          reserve.classList.remove("hidden");
        }
      }
      function qrMarkup(seed) {
        const size = 21;
        const finder = (x, y, fx, fy) => {
          const dx = x - fx,
            dy = y - fy;
          if (dx < 0 || dx > 6 || dy < 0 || dy > 6) return false;
          return (
            dx === 0 ||
            dx === 6 ||
            dy === 0 ||
            dy === 6 ||
            (dx >= 2 && dx <= 4 && dy >= 2 && dy <= 4)
          );
        };
        const hash = [...seed].reduce((sum, ch) => sum + ch.charCodeAt(0), 0);
        let html = "";
        for (let y = 0; y < size; y++)
          for (let x = 0; x < size; x++) {
            const on =
              finder(x, y, 0, 0) ||
              finder(x, y, 14, 0) ||
              finder(x, y, 0, 14) ||
              ((x * 17 + y * 11 + hash + x * y) % 5 < 2 && x > 7 && y > 7);
            html += `<i class="${on ? "on" : ""}"></i>`;
          }
        return html;
      }
      function openReservation() {
        const s = currentShop();
        $("#reservationPhone").value = "";
        $("#qrResult").classList.add("hidden");
        $("#qrPlaceholder").classList.remove("hidden");
        $("#completeReservation").classList.add("hidden");
        $("#qrSub").textContent = `商户：${s.name}｜近 ${s.gates}`;
        $("#reservationModal").classList.remove("hidden");
      }
      function showFlightIntegration() {
        const time = $("#boarding").value || "待录入";
        const gate = state.traveller === "arrival" ? ($("#arrivalGate").value || "待录入") : ($("#gate").value || "待录入");
        const gateText = gate === "待录入" ? gate : gateLabel(gate);
        const suggested = recommendations()[0] || currentShop();
        const safeMinutes = minutes(suggested);
        $("#flightBoarding").textContent = time;
        $("#flightGate").textContent = gateText;
        $("#flightWindow").textContent =
          typeof safeMinutes === "number" ? `${safeMinutes}分钟` : "待计算";
        $("#flightReminder").textContent = `提前${$("#buffer").value || 25}分钟`;
        $("#flightStatus").textContent = gate === "待录入" ? "待补充信息" : "计划登机";
        $("#connectionResult").textContent =
          `航班信息：登机时间 ${time}｜${gateText}｜航班动态待同步。`;
        $("#flightModal").classList.remove("hidden");
      }
      function openPhoto(token) {
        const [kind, id, photoIndex = "0"] = token.split(":");
        const point =
          kind === "public"
            ? publicPoints.find((x) => x.id === id)
            : shops.find((x) => x.id === id);
        if (!point) return;
        const index = Math.max(
          0,
          Math.min(point.photos.length - 1, Number(photoIndex) || 0),
        );
        $("#photoModalImage").src = img(point.photos[index]);
        $("#photoModalImage").alt = point.name + "现场照片";
        $("#photoModalTitle").textContent =
          point.name +
          (point.photos.length > 1
            ? `｜现场 ${index + 1}/${point.photos.length}`
            : "");
        $("#photoModalCaption").textContent =
          `${zoneName(point.zone)}｜临近 ${point.gates}｜${point.desc}`;
        $("#photoModal").classList.remove("hidden");
      }

      const commerceState = { category: "emergency", brand: "all", selected: [] };
      function commerceCategory() { return commerceCatalog[commerceState.category]; }
      function commerceProduct(id) {
        for (const c of Object.values(commerceCatalog)) {
          const product = c.products.find((p) => p.id === id);
          if (product) return product;
        }
        return null;
      }
      function openCommerce(category = "emergency") {
        commerceState.category = commerceCatalog[category] ? category : "emergency";
        commerceState.brand = "all";
        commerceState.selected = [];
        renderCommerce();
        $("#commerceModal").classList.remove("hidden");
      }
      function setCommerceCategory(category) {
        commerceState.category = category;
        commerceState.brand = "all";
        commerceState.selected = [];
        renderCommerce();
      }
      function setCommerceBrand(brand) {
        commerceState.brand = brand;
        renderCommerce();
      }
      function applyCommercePreset(index) {
        const preset = commerceCategory().presets[index];
        commerceState.selected = preset ? [...preset.ids] : [];
        renderCommerce();
      }
      function toggleCommerceProduct(id) {
        commerceState.selected = commerceState.selected.includes(id)
          ? commerceState.selected.filter((x) => x !== id)
          : [...commerceState.selected, id];
        renderCommerce();
      }
      function renderCommerce() {
        const c = commerceCategory();
        $("#commerceTitle").textContent = c.title;
        $("#commerceSubtitle").textContent = c.subtitle;
        $("#commerceSummary").innerHTML = `<b>${c.title}</b>${c.summary}`;
        $("#commerceCategories").innerHTML = Object.entries(commerceCatalog).map(([key,item]) =>
          `<button class="commerce-category ${key === commerceState.category ? "active" : ""}" data-commerce-category="${key}">${item.number} · ${item.title}</button>`
        ).join("");
        $("#presetList").innerHTML = c.presets.map((p,i) =>
          `<button data-commerce-preset="${i}">${p.name}</button>`
        ).join("");
        $("#brandTabs").innerHTML = [`<button class="brand-chip ${commerceState.brand === "all" ? "active" : ""}" data-commerce-brand="all">全部</button>`]
          .concat(c.brands.map((b) => `<button class="brand-chip ${commerceState.brand === b.name ? "active" : ""}" data-commerce-brand="${b.name}">${b.name}</button>`)).join("");
        const brand = c.brands.find((b) => b.name === commerceState.brand);
        $("#brandIntro").textContent = brand ? brand.intro : "按品牌筛选，点选单品后可生成本次出行的推荐清单。";
        const products = c.products.filter((p) => commerceState.brand === "all" || p.brand === commerceState.brand);
        $("#productGrid").innerHTML = products.map((p) => {
          const selected = commerceState.selected.includes(p.id);
          return `<article class="product-card"><img src="${p.image}" alt="${p.name}商品类型示意图"><div class="product-copy"><span class="product-brand">${p.brand} · ${p.badge}</span><h3>${p.name}</h3><p>${p.desc}</p><div class="product-meta"><span class="product-price">${p.priceText}</span><span class="price-kind">${p.kind}</span></div><button class="add-product ${selected ? "selected" : ""}" data-commerce-product="${p.id}">${selected ? "已加入推荐" : "加入推荐"}</button></div></article>`;
        }).join("");
        const picked = commerceState.selected.map(commerceProduct).filter(Boolean);
        const total = picked.reduce((sum,p) => sum + p.price, 0);
        $("#comboName").textContent = picked.length ? `已选 ${picked.length} 项` : "尚未选择商品";
        $("#comboItems").textContent = picked.length ? picked.map((p) => p.name).join("＋") : "可直接点选单品，或使用左侧快捷组合。";
        $("#comboTotal").textContent = `¥${total}${picked.some((p) => p.kind !== "公开价") ? "起" : ""}`;
        $$('[data-commerce-category]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => setCommerceCategory(b.dataset.commerceCategory));
        $$('[data-commerce-brand]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => setCommerceBrand(b.dataset.commerceBrand));
        $$('[data-commerce-preset]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => applyCommercePreset(Number(b.dataset.commercePreset)));
        $$('[data-commerce-product]').forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => toggleCommerceProduct(b.dataset.commerceProduct));
      }
      function openCharging() {
        const key = state.publicZone || "central";
        const availability = CHARGE_AVAILABILITY[key] || CHARGE_AVAILABILITY.central;
        $("#chargeUsbCard").classList.toggle("is-unavailable", !availability.usb);
        $("#chargeDeskCard").classList.toggle("is-unavailable", !availability.desk);
        const methods = [availability.usb ? "座位 USB" : "", availability.desk ? "办公桌插排" : ""].filter(Boolean).join("、");
        $("#chargeContext").textContent = `${zoneName(key)}：现场实拍可见${methods || "应急补给"}；应急线材可前往场内零售便利门店购买。`;
        $("#chargingModal").classList.remove("hidden");
      }

      function bindDynamic() {
        $$("[data-photo]").forEach(
          (b) => (b.onclick = () => openPhoto(b.dataset.photo)),
        );
        $$("[data-plan]").forEach(
          (b) => (b.onclick = () => openAvailability(b.dataset.plan)),
        );
        $$("[data-map]").forEach(
          (b) =>
            (b.onclick = (event) => {
              event.stopPropagation();
              let id = b.dataset.map,
                found = shops.find((x) => x.id === id);
              if (found) {
                state.selected = id;
                state.mapTargetKind = "shop";
                state.positionMode = false;
                renderMap();
                renderJourney();
                $("#map").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
              }
            }),
        );
        $$("[data-corridor]").forEach(
          (b) =>
            (b.onclick = () => {
              let z = b.dataset.corridor;
              renderCorridor(z);
              $("#corridors").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
            }),
        );
        $$("[data-mapfilter]").forEach(
          (b) =>
            (b.onclick = () => {
              state.mapFilter = b.dataset.mapfilter;
              renderMap();
            }),
        );
        $$("[data-publiczone]").forEach(
          (b) => (b.onclick = () => renderPublic(b.dataset.publiczone)),
        );
        $$("[data-charge]").forEach((b) => (b.onclick = openCharging));
        $$("[data-publicmap]").forEach(
          (b) =>
            (b.onclick = (event) => {
              event.stopPropagation();
              let p = publicPoints.find((x) => x.id === b.dataset.publicmap);
              if (p) {
                state.selectedPublic = p.id;
                state.publicZone = p.zone;
                state.mapTargetKind = "public";
                state.positionMode = false;
                state.mapFilter = "public";
                renderMap();
                $("#map").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
              }
            }),
        );
      }
      function renderAll() {
        renderReco();
        renderMap();
        renderCorridor(state.corridor || state.zone);
        renderPublic(state.publicZone || state.zone);
        renderJourney();
      }
      function init() {
        $("#map .map-shell > img").src = I("map.png");
        $("#map .map-shell > img").alt = "西安机场T5登机口与登机口导航图";
        $("#solutionsLogo").src = I("logo.jpg");
        enhanceSolutionCards();
        enhanceCharging();
        $$("[data-solution]").forEach((b) => b.onclick = () => openCommerce(b.dataset.solution));
        $("#closeCommerce").onclick = () => $("#commerceModal").classList.add("hidden");
        $("#generateCombo").onclick = () => {
          if (!commerceState.selected.length) return toast("请先选择单品或快捷组合。");
          toast("推荐清单已生成，价格与库存请向机场门店确认。");
        };
        $("#chargingService").onclick = openCharging;
        $("#closeCharging").onclick = () => $("#chargingModal").classList.add("hidden");
        $("#chargeBack").onclick = () => $("#chargingModal").classList.add("hidden");
        $("#chargeToSupply").onclick = () => {
          $("#chargingModal").classList.add("hidden");
          openCommerce("emergency");
        };
        setOptions();
        let n = new Date(Date.now() + 90 * 60000);
        $("#boarding").value =
          String(n.getHours()).padStart(2, "0") +
          ":" +
          String(n.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0");
        $$("[data-traveller]").forEach(
          (b) =>
            (b.onclick = () => {
              state.traveller = b.dataset.traveller;
              $$("[data-traveller]").forEach((x) =>
                x.classList.toggle("active", x === b),
              );
              updateHome();
            }),
        );
        $$("[data-entry]").forEach(
          (b) =>
            (b.onclick = () => {
              $$("[data-entry]").forEach((x) =>
                x.classList.toggle("active", x === b),
              );
              $("#scanPane").classList.toggle(
                "hidden",
                b.dataset.entry !== "scan",
              );
            }),
        );
        $$("[data-need]").forEach(
          (b) =>
            (b.onclick = () => {
              state.need = b.dataset.need;
              $$("[data-need]").forEach((x) =>
                x.classList.toggle("active", x === b),
              );
              renderAll();
            }),
        );
        [
          "zone",
          "arrivalGate",
          "arrivalStay",
          "boarding",
          "gate",
          "buffer",
        ].forEach((id) =>
          $("#" + id).addEventListener("input", () => {
            if (id === "arrivalGate" && state.traveller === "arrival") {
              const matchedZone = gateZone($("#arrivalGate").value);
              if (matchedZone) {
                state.zone = matchedZone;
                state.userXY = null;
                $("#zone").value = matchedZone;
              }
            } else if (id === "zone") {
              state.zone = $("#zone").value;
              state.userXY = null;
            } else if (id === "gate") {
              const matchedZone = gateZone($("#gate").value);
              if (matchedZone) {
                state.zone = matchedZone;
                state.userXY = null;
                $("#zone").value = matchedZone;
              }
            }
            renderAll();
          }),
        );
        $("#you").onclick = (event) => {
          event.stopPropagation();
          state.positionMode = !state.positionMode;
          renderMap();
          toast(
            state.positionMode
              ? "请在地图上点击新的当前位置。"
              : "已取消修改当前位置。",
          );
        };
        $("#you").onkeydown = (event) => {
          if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
            event.preventDefault();
            $("#you").click();
          }
        };
        $("#map .map-shell").onclick = (event) => {
          if (!state.positionMode) return;
          if (event.target.closest(".map-pin") || event.target.closest("#you"))
            return;
          const rect = event.currentTarget.getBoundingClientRect();
          const point = [
            Math.max(2, Math.min(98, ((event.clientX - rect.left) / rect.width) * 100)),
            Math.max(2, Math.min(98, ((event.clientY - rect.top) / rect.height) * 100)),
          ];
          state.userXY = point;
          state.zone = nearestZoneKey(point);
          state.positionMode = false;
          $("#zone").value = state.zone;
          renderAll();
          toast(`当前位置已更新为${zoneName(state.zone)}附近。`);
        };
        $("#showMap").onclick = () =>
          $("#map").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
        $("#adjust").onclick = () =>
          $(".control-panel").scrollIntoView({
            behavior: "smooth",
            block: "center",
          });
        $("#corridorMap").onclick = () =>
          $("#map").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
        $("#journeyMap").onclick = () =>
          $("#map").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
        $$("[data-plan-action]").forEach(
          (button) =>
            (button.onclick = () => {
              if (button.dataset.planAction === "buffer") {
                $("#recommend").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
                toast("可在行程匹配页调整安全缓冲时间。");
              } else {
                toast(
                  "收尾提示：保存文件，收妥电脑、证件与充电设备，并按现场导向返回登机口。",
                );
              }
            }),
        );
        $("#publicMap").onclick = () => {
          state.mapFilter = "public";
          renderMap();
          $("#map").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
        };
        $("#startTimer").onclick = () => {
          if (state.timer) return;
          state.timer = setInterval(() => {
            state.left = Math.max(0, state.left - 1);
            refreshTimer();
            if (!state.left) {
              clearInterval(state.timer);
              state.timer = null;
              $("#timerHint").textContent =
                "安全办公窗口已结束，请立即根据现场导向前往登机口。";
              toast("安全办公窗口已结束。");
            }
          }, 1000);
          $("#timerHint").textContent =
            "计时进行中，请同时关注航班显示、机场广播与现场通行情况。";
        };
        $("#resetTimer").onclick = () => {
          clearInterval(state.timer);
          state.timer = null;
          state.left = Math.max(
            0,
            (typeof minutes(currentShop()) === "number"
              ? minutes(currentShop())
              : 0) * 60,
          );
          refreshTimer();
          $("#timerHint").textContent = "已按当前安全办公窗口重置计时。";
        };
        $("#copyPlan").onclick = async () => {
          let t = $("#journeyCopy").textContent;
          try {
            await navigator.clipboard.writeText(t);
            toast("安全办公计划已复制。");
          } catch (e) {
            toast(t);
          }
        };
        $("#camera").onclick = () => $("#boardingFile").click();
        $("#upload").onclick = () => $("#boardingFile").click();
        $("#flightConnect").onclick = showFlightIntegration;
        $("#merchantConnect").onclick = () =>
          openAvailability(currentShop().id);
        $("#homeCapacity").onclick = () => openAvailability(currentShop().id);
        $("#boardingFile").onchange = (e) => {
          if (e.target.files[0]) {
            $("#scanStatus").textContent =
              "登机牌已载入。请人工核对登机时间与登机口后继续；航班状态将在授权后由航旅纵横校验。";
            toast("已载入登机牌，请完成信息核对。");
          }
        };
        $("#closeAvailability").onclick = () =>
          $("#availabilityModal").classList.add("hidden");
        $("#closeFlight").onclick = () =>
          $("#flightModal").classList.add("hidden");
        $("#refreshFlight").onclick = () => {
          const states = ["计划登机", "正在值机", "登机口已确认"];
          $("#flightStatus").textContent = states[Math.floor(Math.random() * states.length)];
          $("#flightSyncState").textContent = "航班示意信息已刷新；正式接入后将显示实时航班动态。";
          toast("航班示意信息已刷新。")
        };
        $("#useFlightInfo").onclick = () => {
          $("#flightModal").classList.add("hidden");
          renderAll();
          $("#recommend").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
          toast("航班信息已用于匹配商务停留点。")
        };
        $("#closeReservation").onclick = () =>
          $("#reservationModal").classList.add("hidden");
        $("#backToAvailability").onclick = () => {
          $("#reservationModal").classList.add("hidden");
          $("#availabilityModal").classList.remove("hidden");
        };
        $("#getReservationQr").onclick = () => {
          const phone = $("#reservationPhone").value.trim();
          if (!/^1\d{10}$/.test(phone)) {
            toast("请输入有效的11位手机号码。");
            return;
          }
          $("#qrGrid").innerHTML = qrMarkup(phone + currentShop().id);
          $("#qrTitle").textContent = `${currentShop().name}｜预约凭证`;
          $("#qrPlaceholder").classList.add("hidden");
          $("#qrResult").classList.remove("hidden");
          $("#completeReservation").classList.remove("hidden");
        };
        $("#completeReservation").onclick = () => {
          $("#reservationModal").classList.add("hidden");
          toast("预约凭证已生成，请向门店服务人员出示。");
        };
        $("#closePhoto").onclick = () =>
          $("#photoModal").classList.add("hidden");
        $("#returnSelect").onclick = () => {
          $("#availabilityModal").classList.add("hidden");
          $("#recommend").scrollIntoView({ behavior: "smooth" });
        };
        $("#checkCapacity").onclick = () =>
          setCapacity(currentShop().capacity === "full" ? "full" : "ok");
        $("#simulateFull").onclick = () => setCapacity("full");
        $("#reserve").onclick = () => {
          $("#availabilityModal").classList.add("hidden");
          openReservation();
        };
        $("#print").onclick = () => window.print();
        $("#reset").onclick = () => location.reload();
        const obs = new IntersectionObserver(
          (es) =>
            es.forEach((e) => {
              if (e.isIntersecting)
                $$(".bottom a").forEach((a) =>
                  a.classList.toggle(
                    "active",
                    a.getAttribute("href") === "#" + e.target.id,
                  ),
                );
            }),
          { threshold: 0.45 },
        );
        $$(".page").forEach((p) => obs.observe(p));
        renderAll();
      }
      init();
    </script>
  

</body></html>
